sections.name: Physics
sections.questions_weightage: 45 Questions (Section A: 35 Qs, Section B: 15 Qs attempt 10) / 180 Marks
sections.scope: Units and Measurements, Kinematics, Laws of Motion, Work, Energy and Power, Rotational Motion, Gravitation, Properties of Bulk Matter, Thermodynamics, Kinetic Theory of Gases, Oscillations and Waves, Electrostatics, Current Electricity, Magnetic Effects of Current and Magnetism, Electromagnetic Induction and AC, Electromagnetic Waves, Optics, Dual Nature of Matter and Radiation, Atoms and Nuclei, Semiconductor Electronics.

sections.name: Chemistry
sections.questions_weightage: 45 Questions (Section A: 35 Qs, Section B: 15 Qs attempt 10) / 180 Marks
sections.scope: Some Basic Concepts of Chemistry, Structure of Atom, Classification of Elements and Periodicity, Chemical Bonding and Molecular Structure, Chemical Thermodynamics, Equilibrium, Redox Reactions and Electrochemistry, Chemical Kinetics, Solutions, Coordination Compounds, p-Block Elements, d- and f-Block Elements, Organic Chemistry - Some Basic Principles and Techniques (GOC), Hydrocarbons, Haloalkanes and Haloarenes, Alcohols, Phenols and Ethers, Aldehydes, Ketones and Carboxylic Acids, Amines, Biomolecules, Principles Related to Practical Chemistry.

sections.name: Botany
sections.questions_weightage: 45 Questions (Section A: 35 Qs, Section B: 15 Qs attempt 10) / 180 Marks
sections.scope: Diversity in Living World (Plant Kingdom, Biological Classification), Structural Organisation in Plants (Morphology & Anatomy of Flowering Plants), Cell Biology (Structure and Function, Biomolecules, Cell Cycle and Cell Division), Plant Physiology (Photosynthesis in Higher Plants, Respiration in Plants, Plant Growth and Development), Reproduction in Organisms, Sexual Reproduction in Flowering Plants, Genetics and Evolution (Principles of Inheritance and Variation, Molecular Basis of Inheritance), Ecology and Environment (Organisms and Populations, Ecosystem, Biodiversity and Conservation).

sections.name: Zoology
sections.questions_weightage: 45 Questions (Section A: 35 Qs, Section B: 15 Qs attempt 10) / 180 Marks
sections.scope: Animal Kingdom, Structural Organisation in Animals (Animal Tissues, Frog, Cockroach), Human Physiology (Breathing and Exchange of Gases, Body Fluids and Circulation, Excretory Products and their Elimination, Locomotion and Movement, Neural Control and Coordination, Chemical Coordination and Integration), Human Reproduction, Reproductive Health, Evolution, Human Health and Disease, Biotechnology - Principles and Processes, Biotechnology and its Applications.

subjects.name: Physics (भौतिक विज्ञान)
domains: Units and Measurements: Dimensions, Dimensional analysis, Significant figures, Error analysis
Kinematics: Motion in a straight line, Projectile motion, Relative velocity, Uniform circular motion
Laws of Motion: Newton's Laws, Friction, Centripetal force, Banking of curves
Work, Energy and Power: Work-energy theorem, Conservative forces, Collisions in 1D and 2D
Rotational Motion: Center of mass, Torque, Angular momentum, Moment of inertia theorems
Gravitation: Kepler's laws, Universal gravitation, Gravitational potential, Escape velocity, Satellites
Properties of Solids and Fluids: Hooke's law, Modulus of elasticity, Pascal's law, Bernoulli's theorem, Surface tension, Viscosity
Thermodynamics & Kinetic Theory: First and Second Laws, Heat engines, Carnot cycle, Ideal gas laws, RMS speed, Degrees of freedom
Oscillations and Waves: Simple Harmonic Motion, Pendulums, Wave equation, Doppler effect, Standing waves
Electrostatics & Capacitance: Coulomb's law, Gauss's law, Electric potential, Parallel plate capacitors, Dielectrics
Current Electricity: Ohm's law, Kirchhoff's rules, Wheatstone bridge, Potentiometer, Temperature dependence of resistivity
Magnetism and Magnetic Effects: Biot-Savart law, Ampere's circuital law, Moving coil galvanometer, Earth's magnetism, Dia/Para/Ferromagnetism
Electromagnetic Induction & AC: Faraday's and Lenz's laws, Self and Mutual inductance, LCR circuits, Resonance, Transformers
Optics: Ray optics (Refraction, Lenses, Mirrors, Optical instruments) and Wave optics (Interference, Young's double slit, Diffraction)
Modern Physics & Semiconductors: Photoelectric effect, Bohr's atom model, Nuclear binding energy, Radioactive decay, p-n junction diodes, Logic gates

subjects.name: Chemistry (रसायन विज्ञान)
domains: Some Basic Concepts of Chemistry: Mole concept, Molar mass, Empirical & Molecular formula, Stoichiometry
Structure of Atom: Bohr's model, de Broglie relation, Heisenberg uncertainty, Quantum numbers, Hund's rule, Pauli principle
Classification of Elements & Periodicity: Modern periodic law, Ionization enthalpy, Electron gain enthalpy, Electronegativity trends
Chemical Bonding & Molecular Structure: Ionic vs Covalent, VSEPR theory, Hybridization, MO theory, Hydrogen bonding
Chemical Thermodynamics: First, Second and Third Laws, Enthalpy of reaction, Hess's law, Entropy, Gibbs free energy spontaneity
Equilibrium: Law of chemical equilibrium, Le Chatelier's principle, Ionic equilibrium, pH, Buffer solutions, Solubility product
Redox Reactions & Electrochemistry: Oxidation numbers, Nernst equation, Electrochemical cells, Conductance, Kohlrausch's law, Faraday's laws
Chemical Kinetics: Rate laws, Order and Molecularity, Integrated rate equations, Arrhenius equation, Catalysis
Solutions: Raoult's law, Ideal and Non-ideal solutions, Colligative properties, van 't Hoff factor
Inorganic Chemistry - Coordination Compounds: Werner's theory, IUPAC nomenclature, CFT, VBT, Isomerism, Magnetic properties
Inorganic Chemistry - d- and f-Block Elements: Electronic configuration, Variable oxidation states, Lanthanoid contraction
Inorganic Chemistry - p-Block Elements: Group 13 to 18 trends, Structure of oxoacids, Interhalogen compounds
Organic Chemistry - GOC & Hydrocarbons: Inductive, Mesomeric, Hyperconjugation effects, Alkanes, Alkenes (Markovnikov rule), Alkynes, Aromaticity
Organic Functional Groups: Haloalkanes (SN1, SN2 mechanisms), Alcohols, Phenols, Ethers, Aldehydes & Ketones (Nucleophilic addition, Aldol, Cannizzaro), Carboxylic acids, Amines (Diazonium salts)
Biomolecules & Practical Chemistry: Carbohydrates, Proteins, Nucleic acids, Qualitative salt analysis tests, Flame tests

subjects.name: Botany (वनस्पति विज्ञान)
domains: Diversity of Plants: Algae, Bryophytes, Pteridophytes, Gymnosperms, Angiosperms - alternation of generations
Biological Classification: Monera, Protista, Fungi, Lichens, Viruses, Viroids, Mycorrhiza
Plant Morphology: Root, Stem, Leaf modifications; Inflorescence types; Flower, Fruit (True, False, Parthenocarpic), Seed structure; Families (Solanaceae, Fabaceae, Liliaceae)
Plant Anatomy: Meristematic and Permanent tissues; Internal anatomy of Dicot and Monocot root, stem, leaf; Secondary growth
Cell Biology: Cell wall, Plasma membrane (Fluid mosaic model), Organelles (Chloroplast, Mitochondria, ER, Golgi, Vacuole), Ribosomes
Cell Division: Phases of Cell Cycle, Mitosis, Meiosis I (Prophase I substages: Leptotene, Zygotene, Pachytene, Diplotene, Diakinesis), Meiosis II
Plant Physiology - Photosynthesis: Light reaction, Z-scheme, Photophosphorylation, Calvin cycle (C3), Hatch-Slack pathway (C4), CAM, Photorespiration
Plant Physiology - Respiration: Glycolysis (EMP pathway), Fermentation, Krebs cycle (TCA), Electron transport system (ETS), Oxidative phosphorylation
Plant Growth and Development: Phytohormones (Auxin, Gibberellin, Cytokinin, Ethylene, Abscisic Acid), Photoperiodism, Vernalization
Reproduction in Angiosperms: Microsporogenesis, Megasporogenesis, Pollination mechanisms, Double fertilization, Endosperm and Embryo development
Genetics in Plants: Mendel's laws of inheritance, Incomplete dominance, Co-dominance, Linkage, Polygenic inheritance, Chromosomal aberrations
Molecular Basis of Inheritance: DNA structure, Semiconservative replication, Transcription, Genetic code, Translation, Gene regulation (Lac operon)
Ecology & Environment: Organisms and populations, Adaptations, Population interactions, Ecosystem structure, Energy flow, Nutrient cycling, Biodiversity hotspots

subjects.name: Zoology (प्राणी विज्ञान)
domains: Animal Kingdom: Non-chordates (Porifera to Echinodermata, Hemichordata) and Chordates (Cyclostomata to Mammalia) diagnostic characteristics
Structural Organisation in Animals: Epithelial, Connective, Muscular, Neural tissues; Anatomy of Frog and Cockroach
Human Digestion & Absorption: Gastrointestinal anatomy, Digestive enzymes, Absorption of carbohydrates, fats, proteins, Disorders
Breathing and Respiration: Respiratory volumes and capacities (TV, IRV, ERV, RV, VC, TLC), Gas exchange, Transport of O2 and CO2, Regulation
Body Fluids and Circulation: Blood composition, ABO & Rh grouping, Cardiac cycle, ECG interpretation, Double circulation, Hypertension, CAD
Excretory System: Nephron structure, Urine formation (Glomerular filtration, Reabsorption, Secretion), Countercurrent mechanism, RAAS regulation
Locomotion and Movement: Types of movement, Skeletal muscle sliding filament theory, Bones of human skeleton, Joints and disorders (Gout, Arthritis, Myasthenia gravis)
Neural Control & Coordination: Neuron structure, Generation and conduction of nerve impulse, Synaptic transmission, Central & Peripheral nervous system, Reflex arc
Chemical Coordination: Endocrine glands (Pituitary, Thyroid, Parathyroid, Adrenal, Pancreas, Gonads), Hormones, Mechanism of hormone action (peptide vs steroid)
Human Reproduction: Male and Female reproductive systems, Spermatogenesis, Oogenesis, Menstrual cycle, Fertilization, Blastocyst implantation, Placenta, Parturition
Reproductive Health: Population stabilization, Contraceptive methods, Medical Termination of Pregnancy (MTP Act), STIs, Assisted Reproductive Technology (IVF, ZIFT, GIFT, ICSI)
Evolution: Origin of life, Evidence of evolution (Homologous vs Analogous organs), Darwinian natural selection, Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium, Human evolution stages
Human Health and Diseases: Pathogens, Malaria cycle, Typhoid, Pneumonia, Amoebiasis, Immunity (Innate and Acquired, Antibodies, Allergies, Autoimmunity), AIDS, Cancer, Drugs/Alcohol abuse
Biotechnology Principles & Processes: Recombinant DNA technology, Restriction enzymes, Cloning vectors (pBR322), PCR, Gel electrophoresis, Bioreactors
Biotechnology Applications: Bt cotton, RNA interference, Genetically engineered insulin, Gene therapy (ADA deficiency), Transgenic animals, Ethical issues
